# StreamDek Mobile v2.1.22

Fine-tune sound and subtitles, manage downloads more easily, and enjoy smoother browsing while
your sources load.

## What's New

**Adjust sound to match the picture**
If dialogue arrives before or after someone's lips move, you can now adjust the audio while
watching. Open **Audio** in the player to move sound up to **5 seconds earlier or later**, with
a slider, small adjustment buttons and **Reset**. Changes made here apply to the current video.

For headphones or speakers that regularly need the same correction, set a **Default audio delay**
under **Settings → Audio**. Each new video starts with that adjustment. It is saved on this device
only, so it will not change the timing on your other devices. The default is zero until you change it.

Audio adjustment works with ExoPlayer and mpv. If ExoPlayer is using **Tunneled Playback**, the
player explains why audio delay is unavailable. To use it, turn off Tunneled Playback under
**Settings → Video Decoding**, or switch the video to mpv.

**More control over subtitle timing**
The player's subtitle panel now has a dedicated **Timing** tab. Move subtitles up to **2 minutes
earlier or later**, expanded from the previous 15-second limit. Use the slider for larger changes,
then fine-tune in steps of **10 seconds, 1 second or 0.1 seconds**. Clear descriptions tell you
whether subtitles will appear earlier or later, and **Reset** restores their original timing.
The adjustment applies only to the current video and resets for the next one.

**Download controls in your notifications**
Manage downloads without returning to the app:

- **Pause** or **Cancel** a running download from its notification.
- Use **Pause all** when several downloads are running.
- **Resume** or **Cancel** a paused download, with its progress still visible.
- **Retry** or **Cancel** a failed download.
- Receive a quiet notification when a download finishes and is ready to watch offline.

You can also pause and resume individual downloads from the **Downloads** page. Pausing keeps
what has already downloaded so you can continue later.

## Improvements

**Audio settings have their own page**
Your preferred and secondary spoken languages now live under **Settings → Audio**, alongside
the new default audio delay. Your existing language choices are kept.

**Clearer subtitle settings**
Subtitle settings are organised into language, appearance, timing, behaviour and sources, making
it easier to find the option you need. Settings search also recognises terms such as
**audio delay**, **lip sync** and **subtitle timing**.

**Smoother browsing while sources load**
Reduced pauses and stuttering when lots of plugins or add-ons return results together, especially
when scrolling a title page with its trailer playing. Source results still appear as they arrive,
with your favourite sources, preferred quality and file-size limit respected.

**Help enabling download notifications**
On Android versions that require permission, StreamDek now asks to show notifications when you
start a download. If notifications are off while downloads are running, queued or paused, the
Downloads page shows a **Turn on** shortcut to Android's notification settings.

**Translated controls**
The new audio, subtitle timing and download messages are available in all supported app languages.

## Fixed

- Fixed Home Rows showing generic names such as **Row**, internal identifiers, or missing source
  names after settings sync or an app restart. Previously loaded row names are now remembered,
  including while their plugins are still loading, without changing your saved order or switches.
- Fixed navigation sometimes staying hidden after a touch was interrupted by a screen change.
- Fixed subtitle delay having no effect on embedded subtitles and broadcast captions in
  ExoPlayer. Timing adjustments now apply to those tracks as well as separately loaded subtitles.
- Fixed mpv losing a subtitle timing adjustment made before the player was ready, including when
  switching playback engines. Audio timing is also applied when the player becomes ready.
- Fixed completed and failed downloads disappearing from the notification area without leaving
  their final status. Paused downloads now have their own notification and resume control.
- Fixed downloads starting without a notification permission request on phones where episode
  reminders had never been enabled.

## Quick Setup

- **Fix sound for one video:** Open **Audio** in the player and adjust **Audio delay**. If sound
  arrives late, move it earlier; if it arrives too soon, move it later.
- **Save an adjustment for your headphones or speakers:** Open **Settings → Audio → Default audio
  delay**. Leave it at zero unless your setup needs a correction.
- **Fix subtitle timing:** Open **Subtitles → Timing** in the player. Move subtitles earlier if
  they appear late, or later if they appear too soon. For embedded subtitles and live captions,
  how far they can appear early depends on how much the stream has loaded ahead.
- **Follow downloads outside the app:** Allow notifications when prompted. If they are already
  blocked, open **Settings → Downloads** and use **Turn on** when the notification notice appears.
  Expand a download notification to see its available controls.
